beats.care: You can buy up to four tickets. The cricket association asks fans to avoid cars and arrive at least two hours early.
beats.what: India play West Indies in a T20 at Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, on 14 October. Tickets are on the Ticketgenie app.
beats.why: It is part of a five-match series that is tied one all. The third game is tonight in Indore.

cards.body: About 34,000 tickets are on sale and 12,000 had sold by Friday, says HCA secretary M. Jeevan Reddy. At least 12,000 more will be released in the 24 hours before the game. Free tickets go to 2,500 school students and 250 Army personnel.
West Indies chased down 250 in the last game in Ranchi, one of the biggest successful chases in men's T20 history.

cards.q: Would you pay for a seat or watch on your phone?

opts: The five-match series is tied, so every game counts
India have already lost the series
cards.q: Why does the Uppal game matter in this series?
cards.why: With the series level at 1-1, each match decides who takes the lead.

cards.outcome: Rain washed out the Bengaluru decider on 17 Oct, so the series was shared 2-2.
